id-20260830-news-3.title: MBG Kitchen Partners Hold Peaceful Protest, Urge BGN to Accelerate Activation of Thousands of New SPPGs

segments.src: Sejumlah mitra penyedia Satuan Pelayanan Pemenuhan Gizi (SPPG) dikabarkan menggelar aksi unjuk rasa untuk menuntut kejelasan jadwal aktivasi dapur-dapur baru dalam program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG).
segments.tr: A number of partner providers for the Nutrition Fulfillment Service Unit (SPPG) reportedly held a protest to demand clarity on the activation schedule for new kitchens in the Free Nutritious Meal (MBG) program.

segments.src: Aksi ini muncul di tengah sorotan publik terhadap pengelolaan anggaran program serta evaluasi menyeluruh terhadap dapur-dapur yang selama ini beroperasi.
segments.tr: This action comes amid public scrutiny regarding the program's budget management and a comprehensive evaluation of the kitchens that have been operating so far.

segments.src: ## Tuntutan Mitra SPPG
segments.tr: ## SPPG Partner Demands

segments.src: Menurut keterangan dari perwakilan mitra yang menyampaikan aspirasinya, ribuan dapur baru yang sudah disiapkan dan memenuhi syarat administratif dilaporkan masih menunggu proses aktivasi resmi dari Badan Gizi Nasional (BGN).
segments.tr: According to statements from partner representatives voicing their aspirations, thousands of new kitchens that have been prepared and meet administrative requirements are reportedly still awaiting an official activation process from the National Nutrition Agency (BGN).

segments.src: Para mitra menyebut ketidakpastian jadwal ini berdampak langsung pada operasional bisnis mereka, termasuk beban biaya yang sudah dikeluarkan untuk mempersiapkan dapur sesuai standar yang ditetapkan.
segments.tr: The partners stated that this schedule uncertainty has a direct impact on their business operations, including the cost burdens already incurred to prepare the kitchens according to established standards.

segments.src: Para peserta aksi meminta BGN memberikan kepastian waktu serta transparansi mengenai kriteria dan tahapan aktivasi, agar mitra yang telah memenuhi persyaratan tidak menunggu tanpa kejelasan.
segments.tr: The protesters asked the BGN to provide certainty of time as well as transparency regarding the criteria and stages of activation, so that partners who have met the requirements do not have to wait indefinitely.

segments.src: ## Konteks: Evaluasi Anggaran dan Penutupan Dapur Bermasalah
segments.tr: ## Context: Budget Evaluation and Closure of Problematic Kitchens

segments.src: Aksi ini terjadi tak lama setelah mencuatnya sorotan terhadap potensi pemborosan anggaran program MBG yang disebut-sebut mencapai kisaran Rp10,5 triliun.
segments.tr: This action occurred shortly after the emergence of concerns regarding potential budget waste in the MBG program, which is rumored to reach around IDR 10.5 trillion.

segments.src: Angka tersebut menjadi bagian dari evaluasi yang tengah berjalan terhadap efisiensi dan tata kelola distribusi anggaran program gizi nasional ini.
segments.tr: This figure is part of an ongoing evaluation of the efficiency and governance of the national nutrition program's budget distribution.

segments.src: Selain itu, BGN sebelumnya juga mengumumkan langkah penutupan permanen terhadap 833 dapur SPPG yang dinilai bermasalah, baik dari sisi standar operasional, kepatuhan administratif, maupun aspek keamanan pangan.
segments.tr: In addition, the BGN previously announced a permanent closure step for 833 SPPG kitchens considered problematic, whether in terms of operational standards, administrative compliance, or food safety aspects.

segments.src: Langkah ini disebut sebagai bagian dari upaya perbaikan kualitas dan akuntabilitas program secara berkelanjutan.
segments.tr: This step is referred to as part of an effort to continuously improve the quality and accountability of the program.

segments.src: ## Respons BGN
segments.tr: ## BGN Response

segments.src: Menanggapi tuntutan para mitra, pihak BGN menyatakan bahwa proses aktivasi dapur baru tetap berjalan sesuai prosedur dan tahapan verifikasi yang berlaku.
segments.tr: Responding to the partners' demands, the BGN stated that the activation process for new kitchens continues to run according to applicable procedures and verification stages.

segments.src: BGN mengklaim saat ini masih terdapat ribuan calon SPPG baru dalam antrean aktivasi, dan proses tersebut memerlukan waktu untuk memastikan setiap dapur memenuhi standar gizi, keamanan pangan, serta kelayakan operasional sebelum resmi beroperasi.
segments.tr: The BGN claimed that there are still thousands of new prospective SPPGs in the activation queue, and the process takes time to ensure every kitchen meets nutrition standards, food safety, and operational feasibility before officially operating.

segments.src: BGN juga menegaskan bahwa proses evaluasi terhadap dapur-dapur yang sudah berjalan turut menjadi pertimbangan dalam menentukan kecepatan aktivasi dapur-dapur baru, guna menghindari pengulangan masalah serupa dengan yang menyebabkan penutupan ratusan dapur sebelumnya.
segments.tr: The BGN also emphasized that the evaluation process for kitchens currently running is also a consideration in determining the activation speed of new kitchens, to avoid repeating problems similar to those that caused the closure of hundreds of previous kitchens.

segments.src: ## Dinamika di Lapangan
segments.tr: ## Dynamics on the Ground

segments.src: Situasi ini mencerminkan tantangan dalam implementasi program MBG yang menyasar skala nasional dengan jumlah dapur yang terus bertambah.
segments.tr: This situation reflects the challenges in implementing the MBG program, which targets a national scale with an ever-increasing number of kitchens.

segments.src: Di satu sisi, pemerintah perlu memastikan tata kelola anggaran dan standar operasional tetap terjaga demi keberlanjutan program jangka panjang.
segments.tr: On the one hand, the government needs to ensure that budget governance and operational standards are maintained for the sake of the program's long-term sustainability.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, para mitra usaha kecil dan menengah yang telah berinvestasi menyiapkan dapur berharap adanya kepastian agar roda usaha mereka dapat berjalan.
segments.tr: On the other hand, small and medium business partners who have invested in preparing kitchens hope for certainty so that their business wheels can keep turning.

segments.src: Hingga saat ini, belum ada pengumuman resmi mengenai tenggat waktu pasti aktivasi 13.000 dapur baru yang dimaksud.
segments.tr: To date, there has been no official announcement regarding the exact deadline for the activation of the 13,000 new kitchens in question.

segments.src: Pihak BGN disebut akan terus melakukan koordinasi dengan para mitra SPPG untuk mencari titik temu antara kebutuhan percepatan program dan prinsip kehati-hatian dalam pengelolaan anggaran publik.
segments.tr: The BGN is said to continue coordinating with SPPG partners to find common ground between the need to accelerate the program and the principle of prudence in managing public budgets.

segments.src: Perkembangan lebih lanjut terkait jadwal aktivasi maupun hasil evaluasi anggaran program MBG akan terus dipantau, mengingat besarnya dampak program ini terhadap pemenuhan gizi anak-anak sekolah di berbagai daerah.
segments.tr: Further developments regarding the activation schedule and the results of the MBG program budget evaluation will continue to be monitored, given the magnitude of this program's impact on fulfilling the nutrition of school children in various regions.
